items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Eddie Byrd, remember him? He was on some of your earliest records in ’53.

ctx.x: Debut, right. I knew Cecilia, too, his wife at the time. She was a very nice lady, or still is, I hope.
And Eddie Byrd, remember him? He was on some of your earliest records in ’53.

You mean about Debut. Yeah I used to make playbacks, acetate playbacks, and I had a bunch of labels I used to stick on so you knew what the label was, what the record was. I had a cart of them out here from the printer. Oh there is the house…jeez.
